description: Korean Hroparts TYPE-C-31-M-12 — 16-pin USB-C receptacle, surface-mount with through-hole shield-retention tabs. 5 A / 20 V rated, 10 000 mating cycles. The most common low-cost USB-C connector for maker boards; KiCad ships a matching footprint as USB_C_Receptacle_HRO_TYPE-C-31-M-12.
name: usb-c-16p
watch_out_for: easyeda2kicad import defects fixed by hand: the 4 power pads (A1B12/B1A12/B4A9/A4B9) were smd-custom gr_poly with a 0.1mm stroke halo that shrank inter-pad clearance to 0.10mm -> now solid rect 0.6x1.3; the two center alignment-post holes were PTH size=drill=0.75 (0 annular) -> now np_thru_hole (NPTH). Re-import will reintroduce both.
